units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 38:24">Targ. Y. Gen. XXXVIII, 24</cite> <he>זַנְיַית</he> (O. <he>זַנִּיאַת</he>); a. e.
<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 22:21">Targ. O. Deut. XXII, 21</cite> <he>לזַנָּ׳</he> ed. Berl. (ed. Amst. <he>לזְנָאָה</he>); a. e.—
Keth. 81ᵃ ספק זַנָּאִי וכ׳ there is a doubt, did she or did she not commit adultery?—*Denom. אַיְיזַן f. a runner (after men).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 106a:17">Snh. 106ᵃ</cite> bot. (prov.) <he>מסגני ושילטי הואי א׳ לגברי נגרי</he> (<he>נגדי</he>) after (living with) princes and governors she became a runner after ship draggers (or carpenters). [Our w. is absent in <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 785">Yalk. Num. 785</cite> as well as in Ms. M., the latter having a marginal version <he>אזלא הויא</he>.]
